name: Reverse Lunge
description: Single-leg strength and balance: step one foot back and lower until both knees bend to about 90°, then step back up.

source.title: Reverse Lunge (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
cues: Step back far enough that your front knee stays over your ankle.
Lower straight down; keep your torso upright.
Push through the front heel to come back up.
Hold a wall or chair for balance if you need it.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Lift the foot
keyframes.cue: Shift onto your left leg and lift your right foot.

keyframes.name: Step back and lower
keyframes.cue: Place your right toes behind you and bend both knees.

keyframes.name: Push back up
keyframes.cue: Drive through your front heel and lift the back foot.
